title: ClawVision Mini-Course Plan
subtitle: How to build a free vibe-coding course on top of vibe.egetech.ru
main_takeaway: Best format is a hybrid email course + Telegram channel + site lessons: 7 lessons, each linking to existing site material with one practical assignment.
format_takeaway: The discussion moved from request to full plan: audit existing content, compare formats, pick platforms, design conversion funnel and metrics.
next_takeaway: Next step is a landing page on the site plus a 7-lesson email sequence, mirrored on Telegram.

metrics.title: 🎯 Goal
metrics.text: Turn existing articles into a paced 7-lesson course.

metrics.title: 🔧 Approach
metrics.text: Content audit → format selection → platform comparison → funnel and metrics.

metrics.title: 📤 Output
metrics.text: Course structure, conversion plan, recommended tech stack.

dos: Pace content: one lesson, one topic.
Add a practical assignment to every lesson.
Collect email + Telegram for double capture.
Place soft CTAs in lessons 3, 5, and 7.
donts: Overload users with too much content at once.
Launch video/YouTube as the main format from day one.
Use GetCourse only for a free course — too expensive.
Forget Russian ad labeling rules in Telegram.
next_steps: Create a landing page with a subscription form.
Set up 7 emails in Mailganer / UniSender / Yandex 360.
Slice site articles into course lessons.
Mirror lessons on Telegram with a hashtag.
After 50+ completions, publish a structured version on Stepik.
